note.question: How should regulation schemes, under which the resulting equilibrium joining rate coincides with the socially optimal one, be considered?
note.overview: The model considers an unobservable M/M/1 queue where customers are homogeneous with respect to service valuation and cost per unit time of waiting. It is well known that left to themselves, in equilibrium, customers join the queue at a rate higher than is socially optimal. Hence, regulation schemes, under which the resulting equilibrium joining rate coincides with the socially optimal one, should be considered.
